definitions.explanation: A ceremony held when the framework of a new building is complete and the ridgepole is put in place, to pray for the safe completion of the building and thank the carpenters.

examples.japanese: {上棟式|じょうとうしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{新居|しんきょ}→新居：19007_shinkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上棟式|じょうとうしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Relatives gathered for the roof-raising ceremony of the new house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上棟式|じょうとうしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{省略|しょうりゃく}→省略：03244_shouryaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{大工|だいく}→大工：04051_daiku⟧さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{礼|れい}→お礼：01359_orei⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧⟦{施主|せしゅ}→施主：31100_seshu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: These days many owners skip the roof-raising ceremony and simply give the carpenters a gift of thanks.

notes:
⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (raise) + {棟|とう} (ridgepole) + {式|しき} (ceremony). The everyday word is {棟上|むねあ}げ or ⟦{建前|たてまえ}→建前：06621_tatemae⟧; {上棟式|じょうとうしき} is the formal name.

CULTURAL NOTE:
At a traditional ceremony the owner offers sake, salt and rice to the gods, and sometimes throws rice cakes and coins from the roof to neighbours (⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧まき). It is one of three building ceremonies: ⟦{地鎮祭|じちんさい}→地鎮祭：30680_jichinsai⟧ before work starts, {上棟式|じょうとうしき} midway, and ⟦{竣工式|しゅんこうしき}→竣工式：31099_shunkoushiki⟧ at completion.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {棟上|むねあ}げ: the same event, everyday word
- ⟦{竣工式|しゅんこうしき}→竣工式：31099_shunkoushiki⟧: completion ceremony
